end.summary:
Practised counting sides and corners of triangles and rectangles.
Counted triangle sides correctly in two attempts and rectangle sides/corners correctly.
Explained that a corner is where two sides meet.
A triangle’s rotated position was discussed; the mix-up about its shape was corrected later.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners using the idea that a corner is where two sides meet. Ayaan explained that a rectangle has four sides and four corners, and later identified that a rotated triangle still has three sides and three corners. They mixed up whether turning a shape changes its name, but this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Ayaan to find rotated triangles and rectangles in drawings and count their sides and corners.
